case.geometry: NACA0012, sharp trailing-edge reference geometry required
case.inlet_turbulence: Record the frozen0/nuTilda and0/nut inputs; no retuning

hypothesis.interpretation: An iteration-control hypothesis, not a cause diagnosis or convergence prediction
hypothesis.fixed: Same geometry, mesh, model, references, numerical schemes, time controls and all other settings

primary_force.selection: 80-grit, Mach0.15 tripped Ladson forces, bracketing alpha interpolation at0deg;120/180-grit spread sensitivity with the same frozen bands
primary_force.bands_are: Project screening tolerances, not experimental uncertainty

pressure.current_Re6M_use: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; no experimental pressure agreement
pressure.matching_requirement: A pressure comparison needs a separately matching Re2.88M case and disclosed trip/model applicability

evaluation.force_series: Require a complete finite4001-row, six-column series for iterations0..4000; reject missing/invalid/nonfinite rows or zero normalization
evaluation.both_force_metrics: Each strict<0.005, as defined in TOLERANCES.json; neither alone suffices
evaluation.primary_force_agreement: Inclusive absolute CL error<=0.05 and CD error<=0.002 against selected force reference
evaluation.controlled_pair: A claim about relaxation improvement also requires a compatible matched baseline; a reference comparison alone is not a controlled baseline pair
evaluation.complete_applicability: Force convergence and reference agreement alone do not establish complete validation; geometry, positive volume, mass flux, normal collection, three-mesh evidence and applicable pressure checks remain separately required

limits: No solver run, new mesh, fitted tolerance or airship-hull qualification reported in this preparation.
